en.title: Global Macro — Diesel bottlenecks outlast the Gulf crude export rebound
en.deck: IEA October data show Gulf crude exports recovering faster than refined diesel shipments, creating differentiated risks to trade costs and real incomes.
en.regime: Crude-export recovery coexists with refineries, shipping and diesel stocks remaining constrained.
en.key_risk: Weak refined-product supply could keep freight and household fuel costs elevated despite better crude output.

pt-BR.title: Macro Global — gargalos do diesel persistem apesar da recuperação do petróleo bruto no Golfo

pt-BR.regime: Recuperação do bruto convive com restrições a refinarias, navios e estoques de diesel.
